history.name: Technical notes survive the next edit
history.description: The implementation notes attached to a feature stay attached when that feature is next changed, without having to be restated, so a routine description edit doesn't quietly strip the detail the team relies on. They can still be replaced, or cleared deliberately.
history.dev_notes: cmdUpdate and cmdRename copy prev.dev_notes onto a newly created entry; an explicitly blank dev_notes deletes them.
